ex_en: He was there at the house yesterday
note: imperfect: نكون nkūn (I am), يكون ykūn (he is). Present tense 'to be' is normally omitted (هو تعبان huwa ta3bān 'he is tired'); use كان for past and يكون for future/habitual.

ex_en: I have two brothers and one sister
note: present: عندي 3andi (I have), عنده 3anda (he has). Prepositional phrase acting as a verb: عند + pronoun suffix (عندي 3andi I have, عندك 3andak you have, عنده 3anda he has, عندها 3andha she has). Past كان عنده kān 3anda; future بيكون عنده. Negation ما عنديش ma 3andīsh (I don't have). The 'imperfect' slots above give the present forms.

note: imperfect: نبي nibbi (I want), يبي yibbi (he wants). نبي nibbi 'I want' is one of the most frequent Libyan words; negation ما نبيش ma nibbīsh 'I don't want'. Perfect بغى bghā is less common than the imperfect; يبغي yibghi also heard.

note: imperfect: نزرع nizra3 (I plant), يزرع yizra3 (he plants). جنان jnān = garden/orchard.
